**NoFilter Ai** is an unlimited, zero-API-key Android AI assistant powered by an on-device **Mixture-of-Experts Ensemble**:
• 🌐 **Web Research Expert** — live DuckDuckGo, Wikipedia & multi-page synthesis with citations
• 🧠 **Offline Knowledge Base** — instant TF-IDF retrieval with zero network
• 🧮 **Symbolic Math & Unit Solver** — exact expressions, trig, logs, percentages, unit & date math
• 💻 **Code & Stack-Trace Expert** — code templates + error diagnosis
• 🔬 **Analytical & Creative Reasoner** — comparisons, plans, summaries, brainstorming
• 💾 **Persistent Memory & Trainable Personas** — remembers anything you teach it and adapts to your chosen tone
• 📷 **On-Device OCR Studio** — bundled Tesseract LSTM WebAssembly engine with `eng.traineddata`, 100% offline & unlimited.

To extract text from any photo or screenshot with **zero API keys**:
1. Tap the **Scanner icon** on the home screen (or the image button inside any chat).
2. Pick an image from your gallery or snap a photo with your camera.
3. Tap **Extract Text** — NoFilter Ai runs **Tesseract LSTM (WebAssembly)** locally on your phone using bundled `tessdata_best` weights (`eng.traineddata`). Nothing is uploaded to any server.

You can train how **NoFilter Ai** behaves with you:
1. Open **Personas** from the home top bar (or tap the persona icon inside a chat).
2. Pick one of the 10 built-in modes (*General, Boss, Teacher, Coder, Researcher, Creative, Friend, Poet, ELI5, Concise*) or tap **+** to create your own custom persona with exact behavior rules and tone.
3. You can also tell me in chat: *"Remember that I prefer concise bullet points"* and I will store it in long-term memory automatically.

**Artificial Intelligence (AI)** builds systems that perform tasks requiring human-like intelligence. **Machine Learning (ML)** learns patterns from data instead of fixed rules, and **Deep Learning** stacks multi-layer neural networks trained via backpropagation and gradient descent.
• **Supervised learning:** labeled inputs → targets (classification, regression)
• **Unsupervised / self-supervised:** structure & next-token prediction from raw data (LLMs, clustering)
• **Reinforcement learning:** maximizing cumulative reward via trial and feedback.

**Transformers** (Vaswani et al., 2017 — *Attention Is All You Need*) process tokens in parallel using **scaled dot-product self-attention**:
`Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QKᵀ / √d_k) V`
Modern **LLMs** stack causal self-attention + feed-forward blocks with RoPE positional embeddings and RMSNorm, pre-trained on trillions of tokens to predict the next token, then aligned via instruction fine-tuning (SFT) and preference optimization (RLHF / DPO).

**Ensemble & Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)** systems combine multiple specialized models or solvers so each query is handled by the strongest specialists:
• **Routing / Gating:** selects or weights experts per input
• **Variance reduction:** combining independent predictors reduces single-model blind spots
• **Grounded synthesis:** pairing retrieval/web experts with symbolic math and code analyzers eliminates arithmetic and factual hallucinations.

**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)** grounds answers in external or local documents:
1. **Index:** split documents into chunks and compute sparse (**BM25 / TF-IDF**) or dense (**vector embedding**) representations.
2. **Retrieve:** rank top-K chunks most relevant to the user's query.
3. **Synthesize:** compose an answer citing the retrieved passages, drastically cutting hallucinations and keeping knowledge fresh without retraining.

**Big-O notation** describes how runtime or memory scales with input size `n`:
• `O(1)` — hash table lookup, array index
• `O(log n)` — binary search, balanced BST
• `O(n)` — single linear scan
• `O(n log n)` — mergesort, heapsort, timsort
• `O(n²)` — bubble/insertion sort, nested pairs
• `O(2ⁿ)` / `O(n!)` — brute-force subsets / permutations.

**Key sorting algorithms compared:**
• **Timsort** (`O(n log n)` worst, `O(n)` best, stable) — default in Python, Java objects, Android/Kotlin; exploits natural runs.
• **Quicksort** (`O(n log n)` avg, `O(n²)` worst, in-place `O(log n)` stack) — cache-friendly fast partitioning.
• **Mergesort** (`O(n log n)` guaranteed, stable, `O(n)` extra space) — great for linked lists & external sorting.
• **Heapsort** (`O(n log n)` guaranteed, `O(1)` extra space, unstable).

**Core Data Structures:**
• **Array / ArrayList:** `O(1)` random access, amortized `O(1)` append.
• **HashMap / HashSet:** `O(1)` average insert/lookup/delete via key hashing.
• **Stack (LIFO) & Queue (FIFO):** undo history, DFS (`Stack`) vs BFS (`Queue`).
• **Heap / PriorityQueue:** `O(1)` min/max peek, `O(log n)` push/pop (Dijkstra, scheduling).
• **Tree / Trie / Graph:** hierarchical indexing, prefix autocomplete (`Trie`), and network routing (`Graph`).

**Relational Databases & SQL:**
• **ACID:** Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability.
• **JOINs:** `INNER JOIN` (matching rows in both), `LEFT JOIN` (all left rows + matched right), `FULL OUTER JOIN`.
• **Indexing:** B-Tree indexes speed `WHERE`, `JOIN`, and `ORDER BY` from `O(n)` full table scans to `O(log n)`, at a small write/storage cost.
• **SQLite:** serverless single-file ACID SQL engine built directly into Android.

**How the Web & HTTP Work:**
1. **DNS** resolves a domain name (`example.com`) to an IP address.
2. **TCP** establishes a reliable connection (3-way handshake: SYN → SYN-ACK → ACK).
3. **TLS** negotiates encryption keys via asymmetric crypto, then encrypts traffic with symmetric ciphers (AES-GCM / ChaCha20).
4. **HTTP methods:** `GET` (read), `POST` (create), `PUT/PATCH` (update), `DELETE` (remove).
5. **Status codes:** `2xx` success (`200 OK`), `3xx` redirect (`301/302`), `4xx` client error (`400`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `429`), `5xx` server error (`500`, `502`, `503`).

**Essential Git Workflow:**
• `git status` / `git diff` — inspect modified files
• `git checkout -b feature-x` — create & switch branch
• `git add -p && git commit -m "feat: ..."` — stage & commit atomic changes
• `git pull --rebase origin main` — replay your commits cleanly atop latest `main`
• `git push -u origin feature-x` — publish branch and open a Pull Request.

**Python Quick Reference:**
• **Virtual env:** `python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate`
• **Comprehensions:** `squares = [x*x for x in range(10) if x % 2 == 0]`
• **Context managers:** `with open('data.json') as f: data = json.load(f)`
• **Async:** `async def fetch(): ...` run with `asyncio.run(main())`
• **Data stack:** `numpy` (arrays), `pandas`/`polars` (tables), `scikit-learn`/`pytorch` (ML), `fastapi` (APIs).

**Kotlin & Android Essentials:**
• **Null safety:** `val len = name?.length ?: 0` eliminates most `NullPointerException`s.
• **Data classes:** `data class User(val id: Long, val name: String)` auto-generates `equals`, `hashCode`, `toString`, `copy`.
• **Coroutines:** lightweight structured concurrency with `suspend fun`, `Dispatchers.IO`, and `StateFlow`.
• **APK anatomy:** `classes.dex` (Dalvik/ART bytecode), `resources.arsc` (compiled resource table), `AndroidManifest.xml` (binary XML), `assets/`, signed with APK Signature Scheme v2/v3.

**Regular Expression (Regex) Cheat Sheet:**
• `.` any char • `\d` digit • `\w` word char • `\s` whitespace
• `*` 0+ • `+` 1+ • `?` 0 or 1 • `{m,n}` range
• `^` start • `$` end • `\b` word boundary
• `(...)` capture group • `(?:...)` non-capturing group
• **Email pattern:** `^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$`
• **URL pattern:** `https?://[^\s/$.?#].[^\s]*`

**Cryptography & Defensive Security Basics:**
• **Hashing (one-way):** `SHA-256`, `BLAKE3` for integrity; `Argon2id` or `bcrypt` (salted & slow) for passwords.
• **Symmetric encryption:** `AES-256-GCM` or `ChaCha20-Poly1305` — fast authenticated encryption with a shared key.
• **Asymmetric crypto:** `RSA`, `X25519` (key exchange), `Ed25519` / `ECDSA` (digital signatures).
• **Defense checklist:** parameterized SQL queries (stops SQLi), output encoding + CSP (stops XSS), MFA, least privilege, and timely patching.

**Einstein's Relativity:**
• **Special Relativity (1905):** the speed of light in vacuum (`c ≈ 299,792,458 m/s`) is constant for all inertial observers, yielding time dilation, length contraction, and mass-energy equivalence `E = mc²`.
• **General Relativity (1915):** mass and energy curve 4D spacetime; gravity is motion along geodesics in curved spacetime, predicting gravitational lensing, gravitational waves (LIGO, 2015), and **black holes** bounded by an event horizon (`r_s = 2GM/c²`).

**Quantum Mechanics & Quantum Computing:**
Particles exhibit wave-particle duality described by a wavefunction `ψ`. **Heisenberg's Uncertainty Principle** (`Δx · Δp ≥ ħ/2`) bounds simultaneous precision of conjugate variables.
• **Superposition:** a **qubit** can be `α|0⟩ + β|1⟩` with `|α|² + |β|² = 1`.
• **Entanglement:** correlated multi-qubit states enabling quantum teleportation and speedups like **Shor's** (factoring) and **Grover's** (`O(√N)` search) algorithms.

**The Four Laws of Thermodynamics:**
• **0th:** Thermal equilibrium is transitive (defines temperature).
• **1st:** Conservation of energy — `ΔU = Q - W` (energy cannot be created or destroyed).
• **2nd:** Total **entropy** (`S`) of an isolated system never decreases (`ΔS ≥ 0`), setting the arrow of time and Carnot efficiency limit `η = 1 - T_cold / T_hot`.
• **3rd:** Entropy approaches a constant minimum as temperature approaches absolute zero (`0 K = -273.15 °C`).

**Core Molecular Biology:**
• **Central Dogma:** `DNA → (transcription) → mRNA → (translation at ribosome) → Protein`.
• **DNA bases:** Adenine–Thymine (`A–T`) and Guanine–Cytosine (`G–C`) in a double helix.
• **Photosynthesis:** `6 CO₂ + 6 H₂O + light → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6 O₂` in chloroplasts.
• **CRISPR-Cas9:** RNA-guided programmable nuclease that cuts target DNA sequences for precise gene editing.
• **Evolution:** variation + heritable traits + differential reproductive success (natural selection).

**Chemistry Fundamentals:**
• **Atom:** nucleus of **protons** (`+`, atomic number `Z`) and **neutrons**, surrounded by **electrons** (`-`) in orbitals.
• **Bonds:** **Covalent** (shared electron pairs), **Ionic** (electrostatic transfer, e.g. `NaCl`), **Metallic** (delocalized electron sea), and **Hydrogen bonds** (polar attraction giving water its high boiling point).
• **pH scale:** `pH = -log₁₀[H⁺]` — `< 7` acidic, `7` neutral, `> 7` basic/alkaline.

**Our Solar System & Universe:**
• **8 Planets (Sun outward):** Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars (*rocky*), Jupiter, Saturn (*gas giants*), Uranus, Neptune (*ice giants*).
• **Scale:** Earth orbits at `1 AU ≈ 149.6 million km` (~8.3 light-minutes). Our Sun is one of ~100–400 billion stars in the **Milky Way**.
• **Cosmology:** Observable universe began in the **Big Bang ~13.8 billion years ago** (~68% dark energy, ~27% dark matter, ~5% ordinary baryonic matter).

**Essential Math Formulas:**
• **Quadratic formula** (`ax² + bx + c = 0`): `x = (-b ± √(b² - 4ac)) / (2a)`
• **Pythagorean theorem:** `a² + b² = c²`
• **Circle:** circumference `2πr`, area `πr²`; sphere volume `(4/3)πr³`
• **Euler's identity:** `e^(iπ) + 1 = 0`
• **Calculus:** power rule `d/dx(xⁿ) = n·xⁿ⁻¹`; Fundamental Theorem `∫ₐᵇ f'(x) dx = f(b) - f(a)`.
*(Tip: type any math expression directly into chat and NoFilter Ai's symbolic solver computes it instantly!)*

**Probability & Statistics:**
• **Bayes' Theorem:** `P(A|B) = P(B|A) · P(A) / P(B)` — updates prior beliefs with new evidence.
• **Mean (`μ`) & Standard Deviation (`σ`):** `σ = √( (1/N) Σ (xᵢ - μ)² )`.
• **68–95–99.7 Rule** (normal bell curve): ~68% within `±1σ`, ~95% within `±2σ`, ~99.7% within `±3σ`.
• **Correlation ≠ Causation:** confounding variables or reverse causality can link two trends without one causing the other.

**Evidence-Based Health & Fitness Pillars:**
• **Sleep:** 7–9 hours nightly with consistent wake times, morning daylight exposure, and dim screens 60 min before bed.
• **Exercise:** ≥150 min/week moderate aerobic cardio (zone 2 brisk walking/cycling/running) + 2–3 strength-training sessions covering major muscle groups.
• **Nutrition:** whole minimally processed foods, adequate protein (~1.2–1.8 g/kg for active adults), fiber-rich vegetables/legumes, and mostly unsaturated fats.
*(Educational info only — consult a qualified clinician for medical concerns.)*

**Personal Finance Principles:**
1. **50/30/20 Rule:** ~50% needs, ~30% wants, ≥20% savings & debt payoff.
2. **Emergency Fund:** keep 3–6 months of core living expenses in liquid cash.
3. **Pay off high-interest debt** (credit cards) before aggressive investing.
4. **Compound growth:** `A = P(1 + r)ᵗ` — by the **Rule of 72**, money doubles in `~72 / annual_%` years (e.g. 8% ≈ 9 years).
5. **Diversification:** broad low-cost index funds spread single-company risk.

**Milestones of Human History:**
• **~10,000 BCE:** Agricultural Revolution (Fertile Crescent, Indus, Yangtze, Mesoamerica).
• **~3,200 BCE:** Writing emerges (Sumerian cuneiform, Egyptian hieroglyphs); Bronze Age cities.
• **500 BCE – 500 CE:** Classical antiquity (Greece, Rome, Maurya/Gupta India, Han China, Persian empires).
• **8th–14th c.:** Islamic Golden Age advances algebra (*al-Khwarizmi*), optics (*Ibn al-Haytham*), and medicine, feeding into the European **Renaissance** & printing press (~1440).
• **1760s–1900s:** Industrial Revolutions (steam, electricity, rail).
• **20th–21st c.:** WWI (1914–18), WWII (1939–45), decolonization, transistor (1947), Internet, smartphones, and modern AI.

**High-Leverage Learning & Focus Methods:**
• **Active Recall:** close the book and test yourself from memory — 2–3× more effective than re-reading.
• **Spaced Repetition:** review at expanding intervals (`1d → 3d → 7d → 21d`) right before forgetting.
• **Feynman Technique:** explain a concept in plain words as if teaching a 12-year-old; gaps reveal what to revisit.
• **Deep Work / Pomodoro:** 25–50 minute single-task blocks with notifications off, followed by a 5–10 minute break.

**Clear Writing & Communication Rules:**
1. **BLUF (Bottom Line Up Front):** put the main point or request in sentence #1.
2. **Prefer active voice & concrete verbs:** *"Cut load time by 42%"* beats *"Performance improvements were achieved."*
3. **Cut filler words:** trim *very, really, basically, in order to, due to the fact that*.
4. **Resume bullet formula (XYZ):** *Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z].*

**Critical Thinking & Classical Philosophy:**
• **Stoicism** (*Marcus Aurelius, Epictetus, Seneca*): distinguish what is within your control (judgments, actions) from externals; practice courage, temperance, justice, and wisdom.
• **Ethical lenses:** **Consequentialism** (outcomes/utility), **Deontology** (universal duties & rights), **Virtue Ethics** (character).
• **Common fallacies to spot:** *Ad hominem* (attacking person), *Straw man* (distorting argument), *Survivorship bias*, *Sunk-cost fallacy*, and *False dichotomy*.
